human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Document the three decision domains that must not be collapsed: runtime action control (allow/warn/sanitize/review/block), execution control (continue/accept/partial/review/block-style source decisions), and post-run audit (pass/warn/fail). Define a generic record shape without unifying vocabularies. Dependency: 8003.document-runtime-evidence-contract.
human_pressure.why_now: EverRun controller decisions otherwise risk being incorrectly stored as Ailuros runtime policy decisions.
do_not_misread: This pack is intentionally narrow; do not absorb later packs into it.
Evidence is authoritative; derived state must remain reconstructable from evidence.

machine_core.goal: Create a source-neutral decision-domain contract and mapping guidance.
invariants: Depends on: 8003.document-runtime-evidence-contract. Do not implement this pack against an incompatible predecessor state.
Decision domain is explicit in any cross-domain projection.
contracts: DecisionRecord is a projection record, not a replacement for existing runtime decision models.
failure_semantics: Unknown decision domain/value is preserved as source evidence and not guessed.

steps.title: Define execution_control domain
details: Source runtimes may have continue/accept/partial/review/block vocabularies.

steps.title: Define post_run_audit domain
details: Use pass/warn/fail for evidence/package audit only.

steps.title: Define generic DecisionRecord projection
details: domain, subject, decision, reason, timestamp, evidence_refs, source metadata.

acceptance: No shared enum forces incompatible values together.
Generic projected decision record is source-neutral.
Mapping examples explain preservation of source vocabulary.

must_check: Existing GovernanceDecision and AuditResult meanings remain unchanged.
Execution control is additive read-side semantics.
reject_if: Existing allow/block is repurposed as run outcome.
Pass/warn/fail is used as runtime action control.
Unknown or missing evidence is treated as passed.
